def rec(placed, color_occ, mark_occ):
    global nodes
    nodes+=1
    if len(placed)==len(order):
        if mark_occ and all(v==2 for v in mark_occ.values()):
            solutions.append(dict(placed))
        return
    # Choose next piece: fixed order for now
    name=next(n for n in order if n not in placed)
    col,mark=assets[name]
    # candidate offsets from aligning any marker with a currently singly occupied marker
    cand=set()
    for (r,c),v in mark_occ.items():
        if v!=1: continue
        for mr,mc in mark:
            cand.add((r-mr,c-mc))
    # Sort candidates by overlap count descending and near origin
    vals=[]
    for pos in cand:
        dr,dc=pos
        newm={(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in mark}
        newc={(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in col}
        if newm & set(color_occ): continue
        if newc & set(mark_occ): continue
        if newc & set(color_occ): continue
        if any(mark_occ.get(p,0)>=2 for p in newm): continue
        # marker overlaps each existing marker at most, no >2
        overlap=sum(1 for p in newm if mark_occ.get(p,0)==1)
        if overlap==0: continue
        # reject if colored cells overlap anywhere incl previous marker colors
        vals.append(( -overlap,abs(dr)+abs(dc),pos,newm,newc))
    vals.sort()
    for _,__,pos,newm,newc in vals:
        newmocc=Counter(mark_occ); newmocc.update(newm)
        newcol=set(color_occ)|newc
        rec({**placed,name:pos},newcol,newmocc)
